label: PF Backlog 517
title: DEFECT: /pf product delegates to scripts/pipeline.py (no 'new') -> product generation never starts
body:
## Problem / why
`/pf product ...` -> scripts/pf.py::cmd_product -> runs `scripts/pipeline.py`, which is the deterministic command helper and has NO 'new' command. Running it prints 'Unknown command: new' (exit 1). So the documented product-generation entry never starts a run.

## RCCA (5-Why)
1. `/pf product new` fails. 2. pf.py delegates to `scripts/pipeline.py`. 3. That script is the legacy deterministic helper, not the pipeline runner. 4. The delegate was not updated when the real runner became `scripts/run_pipeline.py`. 5. Guard: delegate to the canonical runner + a test asserting the mapped args.

delivery.note: Fix: /pf product delegates to scripts/run_pipeline.py (arg mapping new/continue/fix) + test. merge --no-ff (no PR)

brief.problem: `/pf product new` printed 'Unknown command: new' and never started a run; the delegate pointed at the wrong script.
brief.what_adds: Delegate `/pf product` to scripts/run_pipeline.py with correct argument mapping + a unit test.
brief.why: The documented product-generation entry must actually run the pipeline.

objective: Point `/pf product` at the canonical runner scripts/run_pipeline.py and map args so `new "<idea>"`, `new <project> --idea`, `continue`, and `fix` actually start/continue/amend a run.
acceptance_criteria: a test asserts the mapped argv for each form
approach: Rewrite cmd_product to call scripts/run_pipeline.py; parse flags/positionals; derive a slug project for `new "<idea>"`; map continue/fix; keep everything else as passthrough.

prior_decisions: single submission path; run_pipeline.py is the canonical runner

risks: slug collisions on identical ideas (mitigated: operator can pass an explicit project)

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/defect_loop.py, core/pipeline_capabilities.py, core/pipeline_composition.py, core/pipeline_executor.py

_note: Delivered + validated (4 tests pass, pf_surface_check OK, compileall, wired-audit unwired 0, lint clean)
